description: Check whether a specific unit is subject to an active recall, from the register: reads only, verifies no signature and spends no chip answer. Returns known (on the register), recalled, and the recall reason, severity, date and id when one applies. recalled:null means the status is UNKNOWN (the UID is not on the register, or the register could not be read) — never report that as "not recalled". This says nothing about whether the item is genuine; use verify_chip for that. Use whenever a unit is about to be shipped, sold, dispensed, or installed. A sandbox key answers its seeded sandbox chips first and any other UID from the register (register:true).

uid.description: The chip UID of the unit to check.

name: check_recall
title: Check a recall
